greeting: Namaste. I am Vaani. I will help you find government benefits for you and your family.
safety_notice: This is completely private. I will never ask for your Aadhaar number, OTP, bank account number, or password.
ask_intent: What help are you looking for today?
ask_state: Which state do you live in?
ask_situation: Are you currently pregnant, or do you have a newborn baby?
ask_age: What is your age in years?
ask_baby_age: How many months old is your baby?
ask_child_order: Is this your first baby, second baby, or later?
ask_second_child_girl: Is your second child a girl?
ask_govt_job: Do you or your husband work in a permanent government job or PSU?
ask_qualifying_card: Do you have any of these: e-Shram card, Ayushman card, Ration card, or MGNREGA job card?
ask_account: Do you have your own bank account or post office savings account?
discovery_card_template: Here is a benefit that may help you: {{name}}. {{benefit}}.
ask_worker_to_confirm: Please confirm details with your local Anganwadi or ASHA worker.
result_likely_eligible: You likely qualify to receive up to ₹{{amount}} under Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana.
result_ask_worker_under_min_age: The official age guideline is usually 19 years. Please check with your Anganwadi worker for special exceptions.
result_ask_worker_window_closed: Applications are normally made within 270 days of birth. Please consult your Anganwadi worker for assistance.
result_ask_worker_no_qualifying_card: You may still be eligible if you belong to eligible categories. Your Anganwadi worker will verify your documents.
result_ask_worker_need_more_info: Some information is missing. Your Anganwadi worker can help you check your eligibility in person.
result_not_not_pregnant_or_nursing: PMMVY maternity benefit is specifically for pregnant women and nursing mothers.
result_not_later_child: Under PMMVY rules, benefits are provided only for the first child or second girl child.
result_not_second_child_not_girl: Under PMMVY rules, benefit for the second child is provided only if the child is a girl.
result_not_govt_employee: Women in regular government or PSU employment are not eligible for PMMVY cash assistance.
needs_account_warning: Important: You need an active bank or post office account to receive direct transfer. Your Anganwadi worker can help you open one.
